stageChange: Dust only: HERITAGE fine structure in the unchanged 250 pc warped-plane layer, with the parent coarse column and Bell normalization.

source.meaning: log10 dust mass surface density in solar masses per square parsec, Gordon 2014 BEMBB expectation estimator. The FITS extension lacks BUNIT; units are established by the paper and author product description.

dust.product: BEMBB, unconstrained beta, expectation estimator, 19 April 2014 release
dust.meaning: Controlled fine-structure reconciliation: the parent diffuse column is multiplied by HERITAGE Sigma divided by its coverage-normalized five-arcminute Gaussian mean. One global diffuse normalization restores the combined Bell mean, with molecular geometry and opacity retained. This replaces no measured cloud column and adds no independent molecular column twice. Missing HERITAGE cells receive identity modulation.
dust.limits: This final candidate uses HERITAGE fine structure, not its discrepant coarse column. The two full-column trials failed the fixed RMS guard and are archived. The footprint is detection limited. The unchanged 250 pc vertical layer may wash out fine extinction. No photograph enters density.

acceptance.texture: The masked 2–5 arcmin bar contrast must move closer to the photo and fine dark structure must visibly improve.
acceptance.scope: Every emitter, luminosity, color, geometry and display control remains frozen at l18.

change: Blue structure only: Gaia smoothing from 200 to 100 pc, with global Gaia and young Bica-association gains.

details.associationSelection: Bica associations in young component, measured age below 400 Myr or the existing adopted 30 Myr spectrum when age is unknown.

gaiaMetadata.selection: Luri 2021 Young 1 + Young 2 CMD polygons; signed parallax/error <5; conditional orthographic proper-motion ellipse with chi-square <9.21.
gaiaMetadata.adaptation: Membership statistics use a uniform Gaia random_index <20,000,000 calibration subset within 5 degrees, G<19. DR3 photometry is used as published; no extra G correction.
gaiaMetadata.source: Gaia DR3 Young 1 + Young 2 proper-motion members

warpPlacement.method: Exact bilinear-cell intersections when fixed-point iteration fails. For multiple crossings, adopt the one nearest the flat midplane. At discontinuous support edges with no crossing, maximize the adopted 150 pc Gaussian height prior and report that finite-layer offset separately. The warp itself is unchanged.

gaiaMetadata.normalization: Unit-integrated equal-weight member counts. One global population luminosity and the existing component grade calibrate appearance.
gaiaMetadata.coverage: Complete archive query to 20 degrees. Zero selected counts remain zero before Gaussian smoothing. No survey-gap interpolation or analytic young-disc continuation.
gaiaMetadata.limitations: All-sky coverage is not uniform completeness: crowding, extinction and astrometric/photometric selection can still suppress young members. These CMD groups are age proxies, not measured individual ages.

barPopulationInputs.product: Qualified BC03 native-metallicity Johnson BVR integration
